description_en: Performs video super-resolution on a video
name: SuperResolveVideo

parameters.help_en: The URL of the input video. Use an OSS URL in the China (Shanghai) region. For files stored locally or in other regions, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.help_zh: 输入视频URL。推荐使用上海地域的OSS链接，对于文件在本地或者非上海地域OSS链接的情况，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/155645.html
parameters.name: video_url

parameters.help_en: The encoding rate of the output video. Unit: Mbit/s. Default value: 10. Valid values: 1 to 20
parameters.help_zh: 输出视频编码率，单位为Mbps，默认10 Mbps。取值范围1~20
parameters.name: bit_rate

Data.description_en: The returned data. After the asynchronous node is executed, invoke the [GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html） operation and deserialize the Result field from JSON to obtain this data
Data.description_zh: 返回的结果数据内容。该数据需要在异步任务执行成功后，通过调用[GetAsyncJobResult]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/607824.html）接口，对其Result字段进行JSON反序列化之后得到

VideoUrl.description_en:
The URL of the output processed video.
This URL is a temporary URL that is valid for 30 minutes. After the URL expires, it can no longer be accessed. To store the file for a longer period or permanently, access the URL within 30 minutes and download the file to your own OSS bucket or other storage
VideoUrl.description_zh:
输出处理后的视频URL地址。
该URL地址为临时地址，有效期为30分钟，过期后将无法访问。若需要长时间或者永久保存文件，请在30分钟内访问URL地址，下载文件转存到自己的OSS或者其他存储空间

Message.description_en: The message returned after the asynchronous node is committed
Message.description_zh: 提交异步任务后的提示信息
Message.example: 该调用为异步调用，任务已提交成功，请以requestId的值作为jobId参数调用同类目下GetAsyncJobResult接口查询任务执行状态和结果。
